chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Dawud ibn Surhan has been transmitted by me from my father, and from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan—may Allah have mercy on them both—from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti and 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Dawud ibn Surhan al-'Attar al-Kufi.

key_terms.الْبَزَنْطِيِّ: Al-Bazanti, a well-known transmitter in the chain
key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ الْكُوفِيِّ: The perfumer from Kufah; an identifying nisbah for Dawud ibn Surhan
key_terms.دَاوُدَ بْنِ سَرْحَانَ: A transmitter from whom these reports are narrated

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Dawud ibn Surhan in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad through which the compiler transmits reports from Dawud ibn Surhan. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving the source lineage of the hadith material in the book.
